batches.title: Validate versioned spell records and fail closed on unsupported effects
acceptance: Define a versioned spell record with source ID/page, level/school/lists, casting time, range/target shapes, components and material costs/consumption, ritual/concentration/duration, upcast/scaling and required mechanic keys. Acid Arrow is the single complete record fixture.
Unknown or unsupported required keys make a record unavailable. Validate existing Cure Wounds and Shield of Faith fixtures against this contract without widening targets or slots.

Offline positive/negative fixtures reject malformed, duplicate or source-less records. Data never registers playable actions or promotes whole-family coverage. Retain pin, attribution and adaptation metadata.

batches.title: Validate versioned item families and explicit variant identities
acceptance: Define a source-linked mundane/magic item family contract with variant IDs, rarity, attunement, charges/recharge, equip/use restrictions and required mechanic keys. Potion of Healing is the single fixture.
Data import alone never grants resources, AC, inventory entitlements or playable actions. Unknown properties and missing variants fail closed; existing potion/longsword fixtures remain bounded.
Schema fixtures reject duplicate/missing variant IDs and invalid source/cost/charge values. Retain pin, attribution and adaptation metadata; all source-listed variants are nested in their family.
